Name: Skillful Clothes Revamp
Author: w8AwA8w
Description:
Made from the base of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8541]Skillful Clothes[/url] by [url=http://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/87498728-lvnaticshade/]Lunatic Shade[/url], this revamp includes 67(42 new and 12 changed) effects and conditions spread across more than 250 clothing items. Some items also include set bonuses active when wearing certain other clothing.

NOTE FOR TRANSLATIONS: !!!!!Change language in game then RELOAD for translations to work properly!!!!!

All clothing effects are fully and easily customizable, so you can change which clothes have which effects for a unique playing experience.

When the correct clothes are worn, you can change the game to become a homestead rancher, a miner through and through, or a fish pond fanatic. This mod aims to make some of the "less efficient" parts of the game better, and add another level of late game goals.

This mod also includes an addon which increases the damage, health, defense, and speed of monsters by respectively. Some monsters have unique changes made to them. This intends to make combat buffs more helpful for players already comfortable with Stardew's combat system. This can be disabled for a more relaxed playing experienced. Separate to this there is also a toggleable change to make critical hits deal slightly less damage.

A complete and continually updated google sheet showing current implemented effects and clothes can be found [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/10G7y0SJhRInFYmZ9mwlo5mXhqrnA4zOM_UX3y-eNFRs/edit?usp=sharing]here[/url].

The source code (not always 100% updated) can be found [url=https://github.com/8AwA8/StardewValley.SkillfulClothesRevamp/tree/main]here[/url].

As of 1.1.5 this mod has an i18n folder for translations, if you make any translations send them to me :)

AS OF 1.3.5 THIS MOD INCLUDES EFFECTS ON BOOTS/SHOES

[size=3][b][u]Set Bonuses[/u][/b][/size]
As of 1.2.1, some clothing also has set bonuses attached to them. Which clothes have set bonuses and what set bonuses exist is fully customizable.

[size=3][b][u]Skillful Wardrobe[/u][/b][/size]
Using the skillful wardrobe menu, (Opened by default with shift+q) save and load clothing sets of your choosing! A set will only be loaded if each of the clothes is found in either your inventory or a chest/dresser/ mannequin which is located in the same location that you are in. For example, while on the farm, it will can get clothes from any chest dresser or mannequin in the farm area. Same goes for any other location and building. The saving / loading of sets is done through either UI or keybinds. By activating "globalfarmwardrobe" in the mod config you can access clothes stored in chests, dressers, and mannequins in the farmhouse and on the farm from anywhere.


[b][u][size=3]Clothing Forge[/size][/u][/b]
Want the effects of an item but it doesn't match your outfit? A mechanic has been added to forge clothing items together. (Doesn't work on hats) Wear the piece of clothing with the effect you want and then put the piece of clothing that you want it to look like in the top right of the tailoring machine. To un-forge an altered clothing piece, wear it and put cloth into the top right slot of the tailoring machine. (Note this only changes how it looks when worn, not the item sprite in inventory)

[size=3][b][u]Customization
[/u][/b][/size][u]CUSTOMIZATION GUIDE:[/u] [url=https://github.com/8AwA8/StardewValley.SkillfulClothesRevamp/blob/013fed26ac45fa37221aef0ed186894c94d082dc/Skillful%20Clothes%20Effect%20Application%20Guide.pdf]HERE IS THE CUSTOMZATION GUIDE TO MAKE THINGS EASIER[/url]
Just like the original, you can change which clothes have which effects through the three json files found in the SkillfulClothesRevamp folder (custom_hats, custom_shirts, custom_pants). It does require a little knowledge on json formatting to edit, but I've made sure to include at least a couple examples for every effect to base customization off of.

[b][u]LessImpactfulClothes
[/u][/b]If you feel like this revamp has made clothes too central to your game, starting from version 1.0.4 you can enable this in the generic mod config menu, or you can go into SkillfulClothesRevamp/SkillfulClothes/config.json and change "LessImpactfulClothes" to true. This will make almost all clothes effects 45% weaker. I recommend disabling harder monsters if you enable less impactful clothes.
(The UI will generally show this, but some unique effects with ranges like mercenary and professional forager do not show the nerf in UI)

Much like the original; No changes are made to the games save data, which makes the mod safe to remove whenever.
The mod is also multi-player friendly, only players who want the mod active need it downloaded. Split-screen coop is not fully compatible with this mod.

[size=3][u]Clothing Shop[/u][/size]
As of 1.3.5 Emily's house now contains a small shop which sells 3 clothing items, rotating on a weekly basis. The shop sells clothes that would normally be tailored and which have reasonably lowkey effects. The location of the shop is shown here:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QPrLmXq.png[/img]

Carried Over From [url=http:///www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8541]original[/url];

Mod compatibility:
 - Deluxe Hats: fully compatible (you can disable hat effects of this mod in config.json, if you only want the Deluxe Hats effects)

Uses Harmony to patch several methods. 

This mod is still definitely in development as of writing this description, so feel free to use the forum to let me know of any bugs or recommendations you'd like to see.

Once again, thanks so much to [url=http://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/87498728-lvnaticshade/]Lunatic Shade[/url] for his work and time on the original, which this rendition is completely null without.

Thank you to squad16lu for the German translation of the mod.
